nose_revision_audit.method: Measure nostril dark stroke centers from actual alpha-composited pigment minus unchanged face base, fixed ROIs, negative mean RGB difference >12. No claimed source control residual.
nose_revision_audit.color_assessment: Viewed 2x actual head and 4x isolated feature pigment on light background. Previous strong orange-red wash is visibly reduced; bridge, rounded tip, nostril strokes and faint local volume remain. No opaque skin patch (alpha max and >=240 count reported), but removal estimates source skin and does not establish whole-source pixel identity.
nose_revision_audit.source_limitations: Underlying source skin is estimated from surrounding skin; not a claim of whole-image pixel identity.
nose_revision_audit.tip_limitation: The recorded (519,446) is a transform target. Pigment at this point is sampled, not treated as a measured tip center; tip shape/highlight is diffuse and not independently certified.
